info.title: SIAKAD API
info.description: SIAKAD API for the mobile app. Log in with `POST /auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer {token}` and, for users with several roles, `X-Role: {role}` (e.g. `student`, `teacher`, `guardian`). Errors are `{"message", "errors"}` (validation, 422) or `{"message", "code"}`. Lists are paginated (`data`, `links`, `meta`). See docs/API.md.

get.description: Public, so the login screen can use it. Image URLs are public and change when the image changes.

push_enabled.description: Whether the server sends push messages through Firebase yet (v6 D39).

post.description:
With the ID number (NIM, NIDM, guardian code or staff login) and password. Accounts with two-factor
authentication first get `422` with `code: "two_factor_required"`; send the login again with `code`
(from the authenticator app) or a `recovery_code`. Send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer …`.
